cards.card_text: Naomi knows where Boaz will be tonight, winnowing barley.
cards.verse_text: In fact, tonight he is winnowing barley on the threshing floor.
cards.snippet: In fact, tonight he is winnowing barley on the threshing floor.

cards.card_text: Then a picture from harvest time: He will scatter them with a winnowing fork at the gates of the land.
cards.verse_text: I will scatter them with a winnowing fork at the gates of the land.
cards.snippet: I will scatter them with a winnowing fork at the gates of the land.

cards.card_text: The One coming has His winnowing fork in His hand, ready to clear His threshing floor.
cards.verse_text: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
